claims.text: TROLL Genesis is designed with a maximum supply of 5,000 NFTs.

The frozen V19 vault has no asset withdrawal, redemption, recovery, approval or execution function for either the NFT holder or project administrators. Transferring the NFT does not unlock its vault assets.
V19 exposes a burn-based reward weight; it does not calculate or guarantee funded distributions.
V19's regulated lane records administrator-supplied amounts and manifest hashes; it does not transfer stock tokens or execute settlement.
